sections.heading: What is trending: “2026”
paragraphs: “2026” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for PL (snapshot taken 2026-10-20T15:05:17+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 500 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Gazeta, Jedynka - Polskie Radio, RMF24. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Cuda Polski 2026 wybrane! Oto 16 miejsc, które zachwyciły Polaków” — RMF24
“16 turystycznych perełek Polski dołączyło do zaszczytnego grona. Tam warto pojechać” — Jedynka - Polskie Radio
“Zapomnij o Warszawie. 25 km dalej znajdziesz taką perełkę. Jest "Cudem Polski 2026"” — Gazeta

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Tue, 20 Oct 2026 07:20:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-10-20T15:05:17+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-10-20T15:06:10+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
